mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_record (user_id, course_id, chapter_id, item_id, item_type, status, first_open_time, start_time, last_study_time, study_duration, progress, finish_time, read_confirm, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{chapterId}, #{itemId}, #{itemType}, #{status}, #{firstOpenTime}, #{startTime}, #{lastStudyTime}, #{studyDuration}, #{progress}, #{finishTime}, #{readConfirm}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE course_id = VALUES(course_id), chapter_id = VALUES(chapter_id), item_type = VALUES(item_type), status = IF(status = 'DONE' OR VALUES(status) = 'DONE', 'DONE', 'IN_PROGRESS'), first_open_time = COALESCE(first_open_time, VALUES(first_open_time)), start_time = COALESCE(start_time, VALUES(start_time)), last_study_time = VALUES(last_study_time), study_duration = GREATEST(study_duration, VALUES(study_duration)), progress = GREATEST(progress, VALUES(progress)), finish_time = CASE WHEN finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN finish_time WHEN VALUES(status) = 'DONE' THEN VALUES(finish_time) ELSE NULL END, read_confirm = GREATEST(read_confirm, VALUES(read_confirm)), version = version + 1, update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT sr.* FROM study_record sr WHERE sr.course_id = #{courseId} AND sr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sr.id ASC
